name: Space Mission Designer
description: 3D aerospace engineering and spaceflight simulation game featuring a futuristic space agency HQ, modular rocket and spacecraft designers, realistic launch sequences, and a 5-mission campaign. AI tools assisted in generating application code, synthesized audio/speech integration, curated aerospace reference data, and visual assets.

aiDisclosure.code: AI-assisted TypeScript, React, and Three.js simulation code generation and refactoring.
aiDisclosure.audio: AI-assisted Web Audio API procedural sound synthesis and Web Speech API countdown integration.
aiDisclosure.data: AI-assisted structuring of curated NASA/aerospace physics benchmarks, vehicle datasets, and LLIS case references.
aiDisclosure.images: AI-generated presentation visuals watermarked where displayed.
